mapper.sql: FROM catalog.dataset d JOIN catalog.publication p ON p.id = d.now_pstg_id AND p.dtset_id = d.id JOIN catalog.dataset_revision r ON r.id = p.rvsn_id AND r.dtset_id = d.id JOIN identity.organization o ON o.id = r.pvsn_inst_id JOIN identity.organization owner_org ON owner_org.id = d.psn_inst_id LEFT JOIN classification.category c ON c.id = r.main_clsf_id WHERE d.mng_stts_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND p.stts_cd = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.stts_cd = 'APPROVED' AND r.rls_rng_cd = 'PUBLIC' AND o.stts_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND owner_org.stts_cd = 'ACTIVE'

d.id::text AS dataset_id, p.id::text AS publication_id, p.pstg_no AS publication_version, r.ttl AS title, r.expln AS description, o.id::text AS organization_id, COALESCE(r.mtdt_cn #>> '{publicationLabels,providerOrganizationName}', o.inst_nm) AS organization_name, p.pstg_dt AS published_at, p.acs_stts_cd AS access_state, r.mdfcn_dt AS modified_at, c.id::text AS category_id, COALESCE(r.mtdt_cn #>> '{publicationLabels,primaryCategoryName}', c.nm) AS category_name, jsonb_build_object( 'details', jsonb_build_object( 'department', r.mtdt_cn #> '{details,department}', 'license', r.mtdt_cn #> '{details,license}', 'updateFrequency', r.mtdt_cn #> '{details,updateFrequency}', 'spatialCoverage', r.mtdt_cn #> '{details,spatialCoverage}', 'temporalStart', r.mtdt_cn #> '{details,temporalStart}', 'temporalEnd', r.mtdt_cn #> '{details,temporalEnd}', 'keywords', r.mtdt_cn #> '{details,keywords}'), 'regions', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', v->'id', 'name', v->'name')), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.mtdt_cn #> '{discovery,regions}')='array' THEN r.mtdt_cn #> '{discovery,regions}' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) v), 'topics', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', v->'id', 'name', v->'name')), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.mtdt_cn #> '{discovery,topics}')='array' THEN r.mtdt_cn #> '{discovery,topics}' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) v) )::text AS public_metadata
mapper.select: SELECT AND d.id = CAST(#{datasetId} AS uuid)
SELECT ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
